deduplication: One recording per unique exact script. Content variants reference stable IDs; repeated number words use the shared number clips. No runtime template synthesis or sentence concatenation. Number clips may be sequenced only in deliberate counted demonstrations.

proposed_production_format.master: Uncompressed mono PCM16 WAV at 24 kHz; preserve original provider output if different.
proposed_production_format.delivery: Mono AAC .m4a; all approved masters and decoded exports reviewed for speech clarity and clipping; final peak/loudness targets set after voice audition.
proposed_production_format.voice_provider: Undecided; Pebble provider/voice is only a candidate. No credentials or runtime provider SDK in app.

audio_priority_contract.explicit_prompt_or_replay: Replace current speech, cancel pending counts, never disable task input.
audio_priority_contract.help: A deliberate help request replaces the current prompt/count and starts the requested support. Any later real semantic move cancels the now-stale help; the child can deliberately request help again. Never lock input or queue old move counts.
audio_priority_contract.count_on_move_return_undo: A real semantic move/return/Undo cancels stale prompt/help/count playback. In counting and transfer, if spoken counting is enabled, speak only the latest actual basket or friend-plate count; no backlog. Joining and remainder checkpoints never automatically announce an assessed total. Deliberate unique-object self-count is a recorded baseline scaffold; requested modeled counting is model help. If counting is disabled, preserve the move and cancel stale speech without speaking a number.
audio_priority_contract.completion_or_navigation: Cancel obsolete instruction/count/help; final success/explanation owns the lane; background/pause/interruption stops; returning is silent until a deliberate action.
audio_priority_contract.effects: Separate control; brief quiet effects must not mask narration. No error buzzer.
audio_priority_contract.accessibility: When VoiceOver is speaking, avoid competing prerecorded narration; define routing in the native phase. System accessibility announcements are not a narration fallback.
